subject: c-act
title: C.ACT.------POL.SIGN.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-7 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's analysis of CORE (Congress of Racial Equality) and sixties alternative-functionalism: 'As early as 1964 one could view the solidification of dynamic functionalism in American social reality, and this was especially true for the emergence of alternative functionalism — as related to the reality position of poor and disenfranchised Americans.' (C)C-ACT (the concept of composite activism) is crossed with POL-SIGN (political significance): the question is what composite-activism produces when crossed with political-significance. PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) branches from the main line and leads to EXP-DY (expansion dynamics), then to INFO-DS (information dissemination). C-ACT itself sits centrally at the top. DEC (decentralization) also branches from the main line. RE-ST (restructuralism) branches from the main line and leads to PHY-U-P (physical universe particulars), which carries CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) on a *dashed* line — the dotted line amplifying some aspect of the main concept it is connected to. A second dashed line from the main line ends at an unlabeled dot and carries GRAD (gradualism) and a further unlabeled line.
